config:
# Paths are relative to this configuration file. CLI flags override these values.
detector:
  engine_path: "26leaf1.engine"
  input_width: 640
  input_height: 640
  class_count: 10
  conf_threshold: 0.20
  iou_threshold: 0.70
  max_det: 300

tracker:
  track_high_thresh: 0.40
  track_low_thresh: 0.20
  new_track_thresh: 0.70
  track_buffer: 90
  match_thresh: 0.70
  fuse_score: true
  gmc_method: "sparseOptFlow"
  gmc_downscale: 2
method: sequential baseline/optimized pairs; CPU 100 warmup + 100 samples; video 100 warmup + 1000 frames; 3 repeats
